seo.title: Thank you: application received
seo.description: Your application has reached Calwebtech. Here is what happens next and how your details are handled.

title: Thanks. Your application is with us.
intro: Your details are with our team, and a person who handles hiring will read them. Applying does not add you to any mailing list.

received.heading: What you sent us
items: The role you applied for, or that you are writing speculatively
Your experience, and any links or files you added

response.label: Expect to hear
response.detail: A person confirms your application has been read. If your experience fits a role, the email suggests a first conversation.

steps.title: A person reads it
steps.body: Every application is read by a person, not filtered out by keyword software.

steps.title: A first conversation about a match
steps.body: If your experience fits a role we are hiring for, we arrange a call to talk about the work and what you want from it.

steps.title: Your details stay in your control
steps.body: You can ask us to delete your application at any time through the contact page.

secondary.heading: See how we work
secondary.body: Read how our projects run, from discovery to handover, to get a feel for the day-to-day.

image.alt: A project team planning a website with sticky notes on a whiteboard
